title: SIN, COS and TAN of negative angles, of large angles and of multiples of pi
note: SIN, COS and TAN take radians: values for negative and large angles to within 1.0E-5 (SIN(100.0) = -0.5063656, COS(1000.0) = 0.5623791, SIN(-10000.0) = -0.3056144, TAN(-0.5) = -0.5463025); the sine of pi is 0 to the precision of the REAL pi; the angle must be below 100000 in magnitude, and the result for 1.0E6 is not a number
